description: Photon is an open-source geocoder started by Komoot and built for OpenStreetMap data using OpenSearch. It supports forward and reverse geocoding, search-as-you-type, a public demo at photon.komoot.io, and self-hosting.
resolution_notes: description: Corrected. The current official README identifies OpenSearch as Photon's search platform and says Komoot started Photon and operates its public demo; it also documents search-as-you-type, reverse geocoding, and self-hosting: https://github.com/komoot/photon. Release 1.0.0 confirms the legacy Elasticsearch code was removed: https://github.com/komoot/photon/releases/tag/1.0.0
